meta.title: Peer2Paper — Independent scientific claim audits
meta.description: Independent reproduction, robustness testing and evidence-backed verdicts for consequential research claims.

footer.tagline: Independent, reproducible audits for research claims that matter.

landing.lede: Peer2Paper reproduces published results, stress-tests analytical choices and delivers an evidence-linked verdict your team can inspect and replay.
landing.signal1Label: From source files to decision brief
landing.signal2Label: Every finding traces to an artifact
landing.howTitle: From contested claim to inspectable answer.
landing.howBody: We freeze the question first, reconstruct the analysis, then separate what reproduced from what remains uncertain.

steps.title: Frame and freeze
steps.body: We define the exact claim, expected quantities, source set, permissions and success criteria before analysis begins.

steps.title: Reproduce and stress-test
steps.body: We execute the original analysis in a controlled environment and test a governed set of defensible alternatives.

steps.title: Verify and adjudicate
steps.body: Independent checks resolve findings, preserve disagreements and calibrate the final verdict to the evidence.

landing.resultTitle: The verdict is only the beginning.
landing.resultBody: Decision-makers get a concise reading. Technical teams get the exact numbers, evidence graph and replay package behind it.
landing.resultPoint1: Reported and reproduced values side by side
landing.resultPoint2: Material sensitivity and source conflicts surfaced
landing.resultPoint3: Every limitation retained in the final package
landing.outputsTitle: Useful at every level of scrutiny.
landing.outputsBody: The delivery package is readable by a stakeholder and structured for a machine.

outputs.title: Decision brief
outputs.body: A plain-language verdict, confidence statement, principal findings and recommended next actions.

outputs.title: Technical audit
outputs.body: Methods, comparisons, sensitivity results, source checks and explicit unresolved limitations.

outputs.title: Evidence package
outputs.body: Versioned JSON, manifests, checksums and replay guidance for verification and downstream systems.

landing.trustBody: Peer2Paper is built around evidence provenance, bounded claims and visible uncertainty—not a score detached from its method.

principles.title: Provenance first
principles.body: Findings point to frozen inputs, executions and review decisions.

principles.title: Scientific changes stay explicit
principles.body: Technical repairs never silently become changes to the research question.

principles.title: Limits survive delivery
principles.body: Missing inputs, unresolved conflicts and incomplete comparisons remain visible.

landing.ctaTitle: Give your next research decision a stronger foundation.
landing.ctaBody: Submit a paper, materials and the decision you need to make.

resultsPage.title: See what a Peer2Paper result looks like.
resultsPage.intro: This sanitized public case study publishes Peer2Paper's aggregate findings and limitations. Underlying research materials and internal audit records are not redistributed.
findings: The primary source report is verified for its coefficient, interval, test statistic and p value, with explicit limits; this is not an independent statistical replication.
Statistical support changes across verified adjusted and unadjusted analysis paths, although both estimates remain positive.
The primary paper and supplemental documentation conflict about the population included in the analysis.
resultsPage.demoNotice: The public repository contains the aggregate JSON record; restricted source and replay bundles remain excluded.
resultsPage.disclosure: The canonical audit classified numerical reproduction as not assessable. The public verdict therefore distinguishes verified source reporting, bounded robustness sensitivity and unresolved source conflicts.

docsPage.title: From request to audit package.
docsPage.intro: What to provide, what happens during review and exactly what Peer2Paper delivers.
docsPage.beforeBody: A complete request reduces ambiguity and lets the audit begin with a frozen scope.
inputs: The paper, preprint or claim document
Analysis code, data and supplementary materials when available
The exact claim or result that affects your decision
Access, licence, confidentiality and retention requirements

stages.title: Intake and preflight
stages.body: We confirm scope, permissions, file integrity and whether the supplied materials can support the requested audit.

stages.title: Study-case freeze
stages.body: Claims, quantities, datasets, code paths and success tolerances become a versioned assessment case.

stages.title: Execution and robustness
stages.body: The original workflow is reproduced, technical repairs are logged and approved sensitivity paths are evaluated.

stages.title: Verification and delivery
stages.body: Findings receive independent review, evidence links are checked and the stakeholder and technical outputs are assembled.

docsPage.outputsBody: Every completed audit is designed to produce the following views, subject to access and licence constraints.
docsPage.briefBody: Verdict, confidence, key comparisons, limitations and actions in readable HTML/PDF.
docsPage.jsonBody: Versioned fields for claim status, reproduced quantities, sensitivity findings and provenance.
docsPage.evidenceBody: A hashed inventory connecting claims and findings to inputs, executions and review objects.
docsPage.replayBody: Environment details, execution instructions and checks needed to verify eligible outputs.
docsPage.statusesBody: Status describes the evidence obtained, not the prestige of a paper or the character of its authors.
docsPage.statusReproducedBody: All required target quantities matched the declared tolerance under an eligible execution.
docsPage.statusPartialBody: Some required quantities matched while others were not comparable, missing or outside tolerance.
docsPage.statusNotBody: The available files, permissions or execution conditions could not support a valid comparison.
docsPage.privacyBody: Requests should contain only data you are authorized to share. Restricted inputs remain separated from public demonstrations and outputs follow request-level release constraints.
docsPage.readyBody: Create an account and submit the exact claim your decision depends on.

methodologyPage.title: A chain of evidence, not a single rerun.
methodologyPage.intro: Our workflow separates source understanding, numerical reproduction, robustness analysis and scientific adjudication so each conclusion has a visible basis.

phases.title: Research and source verification
phases.body: Identify the primary claim, locate authoritative source material, reconcile versions and record what is present, missing or contradictory.
phases.evidence: Outputs: source registry, claim records, paper and code maps

phases.title: Frozen study case
phases.body: Turn the question into a versioned case with targets, tolerances, dataset roles, permitted transformations and access constraints.
phases.evidence: Outputs: frozen case, artifact registry, evidence graph

phases.title: Controlled reproduction
phases.body: Run the original analysis with captured environment details. Separate technical repairs from scientific changes and preserve every attempt.
phases.evidence: Outputs: execution profile, checkpoints, comparison records

phases.title: Governed robustness
phases.body: Evaluate a bounded registry of defensible choices rather than searching silently for a preferred result.
phases.evidence: Outputs: candidate registry, robustness map, fragility findings

phases.title: Independent verification
phases.body: Review numerical and methodological findings independently, resolve conflicts and preserve unresolved objections.
phases.evidence: Outputs: review observations, verification receipt, adjudication package

phases.title: Audience-aware delivery
phases.body: Produce a decision brief and technical evidence package from the same frozen result, with limitations carried into every view.
phases.evidence: Outputs: report, JSON, manifests, replay package

methodologyPage.limitsBody: Peer2Paper reports what the supplied and verified evidence can support. It does not turn a partial rerun into a global truth claim, treat statistical significance as the only criterion, or hide unresolved access and documentation limits.

about.title: Better evidence for consequential decisions.
about.intro: Peer2Paper exists to make the reliability of scientific claims easier to inspect before organizations act on them.

sections.title: What we do
sections.body: We combine reproducibility engineering, statistical review and source verification in one traceable audit workflow.

sections.title: Who it is for
sections.body: Research teams, funders, policy groups, journalists and businesses use Peer2Paper when a published result materially affects a decision.

sections.title: Our standard
sections.body: We value transparent uncertainty over confident simplification. Findings remain connected to evidence, review and explicit limitations.

security.title: Research material deserves careful handling.
security.intro: The web application uses server-managed sessions, row-level authorization and request-scoped release constraints.

sections.title: Authentication
sections.body: Email and Google sign-in are handled by Supabase Auth. Sessions are stored in secure cookies and refreshed on the server; OAuth secrets are never shipped to the browser.

sections.title: Data isolation
sections.body: Row Level Security ensures users can read and create only their own audit requests. Administrative service credentials must remain server-only.

sections.title: Responsible disclosure
sections.body: Report a suspected vulnerability to the configured legal or security contact. Do not include sensitive research data in the initial message.

privacy.title: Privacy notice
privacy.intro: This notice describes the data required to operate Peer2Paper and the controls expected in production.

sections.title: Data we process
sections.body: We process account identifiers, authentication events, audit request details and the research materials you intentionally provide. Operational logs should avoid source data and sensitive content.

sections.title: Why and how long
sections.body: We use this data to authenticate users, deliver requested audits, secure the service and meet legal obligations. Retention follows the request agreement and configured deletion schedule.

sections.title: Your choices
sections.body: Depending on applicable law, you may request access, correction, export or deletion. Contact the address configured by the service operator.

sections.title: Processors and transfers
sections.body: Supabase and the hosting provider process service data under their contractual safeguards. A production operator must publish its legal identity, region and current processor list before launch.

terms.title: Terms of service
terms.intro: These baseline terms explain permitted use; production launch requires review by the service operator's counsel.

sections.title: Authorized submissions
sections.body: You must have the right to provide every submitted paper, dataset, codebase and credential, and must describe applicable licence, confidentiality and retention restrictions.

sections.title: Scientific scope
sections.body: An audit is an evidence-based assessment of a defined claim and supplied materials, not legal, medical, investment or regulatory advice.

sections.title: Acceptable use
sections.body: Do not submit unlawful material, malicious code, unnecessary personal data or content intended to identify protected research participants.

sections.title: Outputs and limitations
sections.body: Release and reuse rights follow the underlying materials and request agreement. Results retain material uncertainties and should not be presented beyond their recorded scope.
